subject: System Design
title: API Versioning
description: A fast breakdown of API Versioning for builders.

hook.text: You update your API. Thousands of apps using the old version break overnight.

buildup.text: API versioning lets you evolve your interface without breaking existing clients.

discovery.text: Common strategies: URL versioning (/v1/users), header versioning, or query parameter versioning.

twist.text: Supporting multiple versions means maintaining multiple codepaths. Technical debt grows with each version.

climax.text: Versioning buys backward compatibility but demands a clear deprecation strategy to stay manageable.

punchline.text: New features without breaking old clients.

quiz.question: Why is API versioning important?
options: It lets you evolve APIs without breaking existing clients
